verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an in-product AI Modeler, an Excel push/pull connector, and an edit-history audit log, but no documented API or agent-facing machine interface for building or updating forecasts or scenarios. OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and nothing shows agent-made changes landing in the same audit trail as human edits. The built-in AI and the Excel connector are adjacent features, not the documented machine interface this story requires.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can build or update a forecast or scenario through a documented machine interface, and the change lands in the same audit trail as a human edit
